card.name: Decimal point in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The period inside a numbered label such as Clinical Studies (14.1) in bracketed cross-references. It also fires on a hyphen after a number, as in 16-ounce.

modes.label: Section number dot
modes.description: The period between the section and subsection numbers in a Clinical Studies or Clinical Pharmacology cross-reference.

modes.label: Hyphen after number
modes.description: A hyphen joining a number to a unit word.
